units.source_text: 老师答应让我升大学一周后，一个下雪的早晨，我刚从学校回来，

en.t: One week after the teacher agreed to let me go on to university, on a snowy morning, I had just come back from school,

units.source_text: 那个没有得到关照升大学的师弟，带着非常高兴的表情望着我。

en.t: when the junior disciple who had not been given help to enter university looked at me with an extremely pleased expression.

units.source_text: 这之前，这小子是不搭理我的。

en.t: Before that, this fellow would not even pay any attention to me.
